text:
maya: Quick heads-up — Acadia Retail POC kicked off this morning. They want to validate: 1) streaming SDK for bi-directional chat, 2) function/tool calling with structured JSON outputs, and 3) pricing estimate for ~500 sustained QPS (peak 1k) over a 2-week trial. Also asked for security questionnaire ETA.

chetan: Thanks — can we get a short checklist of what they need to run locally vs what we provide hosted? Also need an answer on SSO/KMS for the POC.

olivia: Checklist: (1) SDK sample (ws) + handshake example, (2) sample function schema for structured output, (3) example telemetry recipe, (4) creds rotation note. Hosted we provide ephemeral keys + default rate limits; for Dedicated we can pre-reserve capacity.

olivia: Sample streaming handshake (node):
```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?key=EPHEMERAL_KEY');
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'init', model: 'redwood-chat-1', stream: true})));
ws.on('message', m => console.log('recv', m));
```

olivia: For function/tool calls they want structured JSON output. Recommend using `response_schema` with `properties` and `required` to assert shape — we can show sample payload.

maya: I'll paste a minimal function schema we give customers in onboarding. Can someone confirm if that schema enforces types server-side or it’s advisory?

olivia: It's advisory/validation hint — runtime will try to produce valid JSON but we recommend post-validate in the client. We also offer schema-enforced mode on Dedicated with strict parsing (opt-in).

linh: Security Qs: Do they require SOC2 attestation + EU data residency? They noted an internal security questionnaire (30 pages). Who's owning the Q&A?

maya: They asked for SOC2 + contract redlines. I can handle the questionnaire answers with legal for standard items, but anything requiring infra proofs or on-prem will need infra input.

infra-bot: Reserved capacity forecast check: Dedicated pool capacity available in eu-west-1 for 500 qps starting 2024-12-02. If they need <2024-11-20 start, capacity requires a short lead time.

chetan: Good to know. For pricing — is there a short-ballpark number we can give for 2-week POC with ~500 sustained qps? They'll need a figure for procurement to greenlight the trial.

olivia: Ballpark hosted cost: estimate ~ $X/day tokens + $Y/day instance. For a trial we usually propose a consumption credit + optional dedicated short-term reservation. I'll DM finance for a quick number.

maya: Action items: (1) olivia — provide SDK sample + function schema by EOD, (2) linH — review security questionnaire initial answers by tomorrow noon, (3) infra — confirm reserved capacity start date and pricing.

linh: Taking (2). Will flag any items that require on-prem or HSM.

olivia: Uploaded minimal samples here: https://rwd.in/sales/poc-samples (contains ws snippet, curl, function schema).

chetan: I'll schedule a 30-min technical kickoff with Acadia for Tue 10am PT. maya/olivia/linh pls join.

maya: Ack, added to calendar. One more thing — Acadia wants a short doc on how we manage retries/backpressure on SDK. i'll draft and share.

olivia: Quick note for the call: show the structured-output demo where the model returns an array of receipts and we validate schema — that always helps.

maya: Perfect. If any blockers pop up (KMS/SSO), I'll escalate to sales-eng. :thumbsup:

chetan: Thanks team.
